description: Insurance payout from (a) permanent disability: sum insured × disability rate, rates of several body parts added and capped at 100%, pre-existing disability of the same part deducted (Korean standard policy disability table); or (b) a fault-based loss: damage × (1 − own fault %) − deductible, capped at the policy limit (민법 제396조·제763조). Calculation only; not loss adjusting or a fault ruling.

kind.description: disability = 후유장해 보험금, fault = 과실상계 보상

prior.description: Pre-existing disability rate of the same part, fraction

items.description: Disability rate as a fraction, e.g. 0.5
